data.one_liner: A Server-Sent Events client for Dart and Flutter with auto-reconnection.
data.what_it_does: Handles connection, parsing, and data management for Server-Sent Events (SSE) streams in Dart and Flutter. It supports auto-reconnection with backoff, interceptors, mid-flight request aborts, and web platform integration.
use_when: Your application needs to consume a Server-Sent Events (SSE) stream from a backend
You require automatic reconnection logic with exponential or linear backoff
You need web support for SSE streams with CORS and custom headers
avoid_when: Your backend uses traditional REST requests without streaming
You are building a real-time bidirectional feature that strictly requires WebSockets instead of server-to-client streaming
strengths: WHATWG SSE spec-compliant parsing with lastEventId and retry support
Built-in auto-reconnection with exponential and linear backoff, jitter, and max backoff capping
Supports interceptors, mid-flight aborts, and idle timeout detection
weaknesses: Limited primarily to Server-Sent Events rather than full WebSocket bidirectional messaging
Requires webConfig setup specifically on the web platform
data.setup_notes: Requires Dart SDK >=3.4.0 and Flutter >=3.0.0. On web, requires passing a WebConfig instance to the connect method.
